name: Akshay Kumar Controlling Hand (Housefull 3)
visual_description: Akshay Kumar clenches his teeth while physically restraining his own extending arm.
usage_context: Used to show extreme self-control against doing an impulsive, aggressive, or petty act.

example.caption: Me stopping myself from saying 'told you so' to my best friend

text_areas.description: The impulsive urge or response being restrained
